proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided RMA APIs (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) wired into runtime task creation, planning, and launch flow (enqueue). Additional substantive scopes: a new in-node CE execution path and signal synchronization for RMA operations (copy-engine), a cross-node GIN proxy transport/plugin path with new proxy context/progress/registration behavior (gin), communicator config/capability lifecycle and async-error/property exposure for host RMA enablement (communicator), and new profiler event/ABI surface for RMA API events plus inspector function mapping (profiler).
